do: State trade-offs honestly, including when the product is not the right fit
Lead with privacy and independence as core values, not features
Use short, declarative sentences with concrete specifics
Reference open source and EU hosting as accountability mechanisms, not just selling points
Let customer outcomes and word-of-mouth speak rather than making claims about growth
dont: Make vague superlative claims without evidence
Oversell — the brand explicitly says when it is not a fit
Invent metrics or testimonials not present in the scraped content
